summary: Lewis Hamilton faces redemption in Austin after his costly Singapore blunder hands Kimi Antonelli the chance to clinch the world championship this weekend. Ferrari's resurgent machinery and strategic execution will face off against the pressure-cooker tactics of a wounded Mercedes team desperate to keep Antonelli's coronation at bay. A title-deciding weekend in Texas would cement Antonelli as the sport's newest champion while defining whether Hamilton's mistake becomes a footnote or a defining moment in his legacy.
